categories.main_business_segments: Inner Mongolia Baotou Steel Union Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the steel industry, engaging in mining, beneficiation, coking, sintering, pelletizing, ironmaking, steelmaking, and rolling processes. The company produces and sells steel products including hot-rolled coils, cold-rolled coils, galvanized steel, medium-thick plates, seamless pipes, heavy rails, profiles, and construction steel. It also develops and sells rare earth concentrates and fluorite concentrates, serving industries such as infrastructure, railways, real estate, automotive, home appliances, wind power, machinery manufacturing, high-pressure boilers, petrochemicals, and strategic emerging sectors. Additionally, the company is involved in coal coking and chemical products production and sales, metallurgical machinery, equipment and parts, and automotive cargo transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced steel production technologies including CSP, wide and thick plate production lines, hot and cold rolling, continuous annealing, galvanizing, and electrical steel annealing coating lines. It has world-leading universal rolling mills for high-speed rail steel production and multiple seamless pipe production lines certified internationally. The rare earth steel production leverages over 50 years of R&D, including mold casting and continuous casting processes, producing various rare earth steel materials. The company also implements intelligent manufacturing with industrial robots, centralized control systems, and digital workshops, and pursues green low-carbon technologies such as ultra-low emission retrofits, energy efficiency projects, and carbon footprint accounting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries in infrastructure construction, railways, real estate, automotive manufacturing, home appliances, wind power, machinery manufacturing, high-pressure boilers, and petrochemicals. The company serves major domestic clients including central enterprises and regional state-owned enterprises, and exports products to developed countries in Europe, America, Korea, Japan, and countries along the Belt and Road Initiative in Asia, the Middle East, South America, and Africa. Strategic customers include six new automotive OEMs and leading enterprises in home appliances and wind power sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Inner Mongolia, China, with its headquarters in Baotou City. It has a nationwide marketing network covering North China, Central China, East China, South China, Southwest China, Northwest China, and a local spot sales center, forming a '6+1' regional marketing platform. Internationally, it exports to Europe, America, Korea, Japan, and Belt and Road countries in Asia, the Middle East, South America, and Africa. The company benefits from its strategic location near coal-rich Shanxi and Shaanxi provinces and resource-rich Mongolia and Russia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Inner Mongolia Baotou Steel Union Co., Ltd. operates across the upstream to downstream spectrum of the steel industry supply chain. It controls upstream mining and beneficiation of iron ore, rare earth, and fluorite minerals, midstream coking, sintering, ironmaking, steelmaking, and rolling production, and downstream sales and distribution of steel products. It also integrates coal coking and chemical production, metallurgical machinery manufacturing, and logistics services, positioning itself as a comprehensive steel and resource development enterprise.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality development with strategic priorities on optimizing product structure towards 'high-quality boutique steel + series of rare earth steels.' It emphasizes technological innovation in rare earth steel materials, green low-carbon steel production, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D initiatives include developing high-performance automotive steel, rare earth welding wire steel, high-strength hydroelectric steel, and new energy steel materials. The company invests over 5% of revenue in R&D, maintains national and provincial research platforms, and accelerates technology transfer and industrialization of innovations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of steel products, rare earth concentrates, and related mineral products. The company employs direct sales and distribution channels domestically and exports internationally. It also earns income from coal coking and chemical product sales, metallurgical machinery and equipment sales, and automotive cargo transportation services. Additionally, government subsidies and investment income contribute to other revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest steel listed company in western China and one of the top five steel rail producers in China. It holds a leading position in rare earth steel new materials and seamless pipe production with comprehensive product specifications. Its strategic positioning emphasizes high-end, rare earth steel products and green low-carbon transformation, aiming to be a leading rare earth steel new materials supplier and service provider domestically and internationally. Competitors include other major Chinese steel producers and rare earth material companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 68.09 billion, a slight decrease of 3.51% compared to the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 264.63 million, down 48.64% year-on-year. Total assets reached RMB 155.13 billion, up 2.21%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 51.91 billion, stable year-on-year. The company maintains a stable production scale with 14.21 million tons of iron and 14.99 million tons of steel produced in 2024. It continues to invest heavily in R&D and infrastructure to support growth and transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company leverages its unique resource advantage of the world’s largest rare earth mine at Baiyun Obo, integrating rare earth with iron ore to produce rare earth steel materials that are stronger, tougher, and more durable. It emphasizes high-end, high-performance steel products tailored for automotive, home appliance, wind power, and strategic emerging industries. The company’s green low-carbon production capabilities, intelligent manufacturing, and comprehensive product portfolio provide differentiated value. Its commitment to quality, innovation, and environmental responsibility positions it as a leading supplier of rare earth steel new materials with strong brand recognition.
